title: Kīhei former institute property housing redevelopment
summary: On April 6, 2026, the county said it is choosing a developer to get a sublease to redevelop the Kīhei interim housing property, after the housing department issued an RFP in March. County money would keep the program, which first housed wildfire survivors, running through February of next year. The county holds a 75-year ground lease on the former hotel, which the state bought for $45 million.
